note: Every lane declares a mode; the mode's posture (broad/tight) decides the prompt and the caps. x_search accepts at most 20 handles per allowed_x_handles call, and allowed/excluded are mutually exclusive.

xLanes.label: The 10 watched accounts — funding, broad
xLanes.query: Every company mentioned as raising a round, announcing a valuation, hitting an ARR milestone, or reaching unicorn or late stage. Capture all of them.

xLanes.label: Open funding keyword sweep — broad
xLanes.query: Companies announcing a seed, Series A, Series B, Series C, Series D or Series E round, a new valuation, sharp ARR growth, or unicorn status

xLanes.label: NYC office expansion — tight
xLanes.query: Companies signing a New York office lease, opening their first NYC office, moving to a larger New York space, relocating their headquarters to Manhattan, or leaving coworking for their own NYC space

xLanes.label: NYC hiring and team growth — tight
xLanes.query: Companies hiring multiple roles in New York City, announcing a senior New York hire (VP, Head of, CRO, COO, Chief of Staff), building out their NYC team, hiring an office or facilities manager in New York, or doubling or tripling headcount

xLanes.label: Founder space-pressure language — tight
xLanes.query: Founders and CEOs saying they are outgrowing their current office, actively looking for office space in New York, need more space, are moving from remote to in-person, or just hit 20, 50, or 100 people

webLanes.label: Funding announcements across the web — broad
webLanes.query: startup funding announcements: seed, Series A, Series B, Series C, Series D, Series E, new valuation, ARR milestone, unicorn — in AI, software, fintech, healthtech, robotics, enterprise SaaS, or developer tools

webLanes.label: NYC office moves and expansions — tight
webLanes.query: company signed a New York City office lease OR opened its first NYC office OR relocated headquarters to Manhattan OR moved to a larger New York office OR outgrew its current New York space

webLanes.label: NYC hiring surges and workplace hires — tight
webLanes.query: company hiring multiple roles in New York City, building out a New York team, or hiring a Head of Workplace, Head of Facilities, or Office Manager in NYC

webLanes.label: Founder statements of space pressure — tight
webLanes.query: founder or CEO interview or post saying the company outgrew its New York office, is looking for office space in NYC, or hit a headcount milestone that forced a move
